svg.title: The heater's response to a held command step
svg.desc: With the command held at 85 percent the temperature does not move for 1.0 second, then rises fastest at first, covers 63 percent of its change 5 seconds after it started moving and ends at 36.99 degrees Celsius. In the controlled trial the PI command keeps changing, so that trace cannot show the heater alone.
svg.text: The heater alone: a held command step from 75 to 85 %
